seo.title: The 7-night wind-down plan | Larkspur Sleep
seo.description: A free, printable plan for building an evening routine that helps you fall asleep sooner. One small change a night for a week.

hero.headline: Fall asleep sooner in seven nights
hero.subhead: A printable plan with one small change to your evening each night. No apps, no supplements, no 5am alarms.

items.title: A night-by-night checklist
items.body: Seven short steps, each one building on the last, so the routine sticks.

items.title: A wind-down timer
items.body: When to dim the lights, put the phone away and start reading, worked back from your bedtime.

items.title: A sleep log
items.body: One page to track what changed, so you can keep what works and drop what doesn't.
